text:
Ari: quick sync — launching a small experiment next week to reduce pricing page cognitive load and improve demo signups. idea is to test a minimal 'cost estimator' microflow vs a static price table.
Priya: +1. can we tie one variant to a webinar CTA instead of demo? low intent -> webinar, high intent -> demo.
Lenny: love that. can we also test micro-FAQs prioritized by persona (startup, scale, enterprise) rather than full FAQ dump?
Kelsey: CS + sales prefer the persona routing. helps inbound triage. want to route enterprise answers to sales queue via hidden form field.
Ari: for clarity, plan A = simplified bands + persona micro-FAQ + demo CTA; Plan B = interactive estimator microflow + dynamic CTA (webinar/demo based on answers).
Priya: do we have a short benchmark narrative / hypothesis we can include in the experiment doc? e.g., "Reducing choices and matching CTA to intent will increase demo requests and reduce dropoff".
Lenny: yep — hypothesis: "Estimator increases time-on-page but clarity-first design (Plan A) increases demo conversion by steering users quickly."
Kelsey: routing rules: enterprise signal = company_size>200 OR company_email_domain matches list -> route to sales; else go to SDR funnel. we'll add hidden utm to maintain experimental bucket.
GrowthBot: created experiment id xpr-2098 and feature-flag rollout channel=marketing, start=2026-03-30.
Ari: copy drafts inlined below — keep them short.

```
Plan A CTA: "Get a dedicated demo"
Plan A micro-FAQ header: "Which plan fits my team?"
Plan B CTA flow: "Estimate monthly cost" -> quiz -> "Join a short webinar" or "Request a demo"
```
Priya: microcopy tweak: change "Get a dedicated demo" to "Schedule a 15‑minute demo" — clearer ask.
Lenny: also add small commitment badge under CTA for Plan A: "SLA-backed latency, monthly billing available" — helps enterprise trust.
Kelsey: how will analytics track intent? suggested signals = estimator completion, time-on-page>90s, CTA click, form dropoff. we should instrument flags for each.
Ari: agree. success metrics: +15% demo clicks for Plan A, +10% webinar signups for Plan B, and -8% bounce for either. secondary metric: higher MQL rate from enterprise route.
Priya: timeline: copy + designs by Tue, QA + instrumentation Wed-Thu, soft launch Fri. can we get dev slot for backend routing Fri morning?
Lenny: dev pinged — @growthdev on call Fri 10am. also need to add a small snippet on the pricing page for a/b opt-out for existing customers.
Kelsey: I'll coordinate with CS on inbound routing doc and update the playbook.
Ari: last note: include a short benchmark paragraph for marketing assets — say we saw X% lift in demo requests during previous simplified pricing pilot (Q4) — we can reuse language but avoid exact numbers publicly. marketing wants a 1-liner: "Simpler pricing, clearer next steps."
Priya: adding that to the webinar pitch: "See how top teams optimize cost and latency — join our 30‑min session."
GrowthBot: experiment xpr-2098 updated with goals and tags: [pricing-experiment, cost-estimator, webinar-routing].
Ari: cool — I'll put the experiment doc in the marketing drive and ping design + growthdev. any blockers?
Lenny: none from product.
Kelsey: CS will prepare canned replies for webinar leads.
Priya: thanks — will post the launch announcement once QA passes. :rocket:
